messages:
alice: Quick sync — we need a TTL policy for catalog entries and clear rollback thresholds for migrations. Customers are asking about pinned model expiry.
ben: Agree. Proposal: default TTL 180 days for unpinned artifacts, 365 for pinned exceptions? Thoughts?
carla: prefer not to auto-expire pinned models. Flag them 'stale' after 180d and require PM approval to unpin/archive.
emily: From support: customers expect notices at 90/30/14/7 days before any deprecation. We should do automated emails + in-console banners.
marco: technical reality: we can't keep every version forever — storage + serving variants blow up. TTL needed for unpinned artifacts, but must be configurable per org.
alice: what about phased deprecation states: notice -> restriction on new pins -> soft-deprecate (read-only) -> archive?
ben: sketch of config and thresholds:
```
notice_days: [90,30,14,7]
soft_deprecate_after_days: 30
archive_after_days: 365
canary_rollout: [10,50,100]
rollback_triggers: {
  "latency_p95_increase_pct": "10",
  "error_rate_increase_pct": "0.5",
  "eval_quality_drop_pct": "2"
}
```
carla: rollback triggers need to be concrete and measurable. Use p95 latency, request error rate, and eval set quality delta over a 24h window. Also specify lookback (baseline 7d median).
emily: must include customer opt-outs and enterprise contract flags: e.g., `never-auto-archive` or `extended-ttl: n days` tied to billing/contract. Support needs warnings in tickets when a model is marked stale.
marco: implementation note: archive means remove from fast store and move to cold blob with a manifest. Serving fallback should route archived requests to latest compatible variant.
ops-bot: migration-runner v2 started by alice at 1806009900, job id mr-20260312-7 triggered for dry-run.
ben: action items: I'll draft the TTL config schema + console banner UI. @carla can you add exact metric defs and thresholds? @emily can you draft comms templates for the 90/30/14/7 cadence?
carla: will add metric definitions. propose immediate rollback at >10% p95 regression or >1% error increase during canary window, softer for full rollout (5%/0.5%).
alice: agree on canary windows. we should also require a quality-evals pass — failing evals should block rollout automatically.
emily: comms templates: incident-style + scheduled deprecation notice + personalized outreach for customers with pins. I can have a first pass by Thu.
ben: I'll open PR for the backend TTL config and add migration-runner flags for soft-deprecate/archive.
marco: need an ops checklist: pre-migration smoke tests, fallback mapping, storage reclamation plan.
alice: timeline: RFC this week, implementation spike next sprint, docs + comms parallel, aim for small pilot end of month.
emily: support will prepare FAQ and ticket templates.
ben: noted. linking internal doc for iteration: https://redwood.internal/docs/catalog-lifecycle (private)
carla: one more: add audit log entries for pin/unpin/archive actions and a visible 'stale' filter in console.
alice: perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
